title_sq: Tek Vila Gold, Shitet Apartament 1+1 Ne Faze Perfundimtare !

title_en: At Vila Gold, 1+1 apartment for sale in the final phase!
description_en: ek Vila Gold, 1+1 apartment for sale in the final phase. The apartment has a gross area of ​​85.7 m2, net 74.5 m2 and is located on the second residential floor of a 10-story building which is in the final stages of construction. The apartment is organized in the living room together with the kitchenette with access to the balcony, a bedroom also with access to the balcony and a toilet. The area in which the apartment is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life, making it a very good opportunity for both residence and investment.
